heading: Our Services
subheading: The Complete Restoration Company brings period beauty back to life, making sure each project or item fits perfectly for contemporary or traditional living and design.
introHtml:
From floor restoration to shot blasting, we use a wide range of techniques to undertake a broad range of restoration work on all types of building restoration, architectural features and period furniture.

Take a look at our website and discover the type of work we undertake and some examples of work we’ve done in the past. If you’ve got a specific project that you would like advice on or help with, then please feel free to get in touch.
